title: Knockout Yeasty American Clams Chowder
description: A comforting and flavorful dish featuring clams, tempering chocolate, and a yeasty twist, perfect for a sick day. This raw-friendly and crumbly American chowder is sure to knock you out
instructions: Melt the tempering chocolate in a double boiler over low heat, stirring occasionally.
In a large pot, saute the chopped onions and minced garlic in a little bit of oil until softened.
Add the diced potatoes, clams, yeast, and chicken broth to the pot, stirring to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat and let simmer for 15 minutes.
Use an immersion blender to puree the soup until slightly smooth.
Stir in the melted chocolate and heavy cream, if using.
Season the soup with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the chowder hot, garnished with chopped herbs or a sprinkle of paprika.
Cook poultry to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F before serving.
